title: Kundler Klamm Naturschlucht
highlights: Breiter, ebener und barrierefreier Wanderweg durch eine imposante Dolomit-Felsenschlucht
Tosende Wildschoenauer Ache mit bizarren Felsueberhaengen und ausgewaschenen Gesteinen
Traditioneller Bummelzug ab Wildschoenau bis direkt zum Klammeingang
Paradies fuer Steinesammler mit seltenen geologischen Gesteinsfunden
kurzbeschreibung: The Kundler Klamm connects the Wildschönau with the Inntal via an idyllic, stroller-friendly rocky path alongside a roaring torrent.
beschreibung:
Natural Connection Between Two Valleys

The Kundler Klamm is considered one of Tyrol's most charming and easily accessible gorges. The wide, shaded walking trail follows the roaring Wildschönauer Ache, directly connecting the high valleys of the Wildschönau with the Inntal near Kundl.

Legendary Rock Formations

According to legend, a dragon bit the gorge into the rock before being defeated. Today, families and geology enthusiasts particularly value the trail for its impressive rock faces and the chance to hunt for colorful pebbles in the shallow riverbed.
